schema_version.description: Export schema. 1.3.0 adds (append-only) recheck_days and the provider_country* / pending_recheck* / last_verified_date_utc8 row fields; every 1.2.0 field is unchanged.

usd_cny.description: USD→CNY rate of the same snapshot (for optional conversion).

recheck_days.description: (1.3.0) Days after verified_at at which a row is flagged pending_recheck (14).

cite_as.description: (1.3.0) Plain-text citation of this snapshot: "apiprice.app (YYYY). apiprice.app LLM API Prices [Data set], snapshot as of YYYY-MM-DD, schema X. CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/alchemistklk/apiprice-data" (UTC+8 date of generated_at).

model_id.description: apiprice.app model slug (stable key). Not necessarily the provider API model string.

provider.description: Provider id, e.g. openai, deepseek, qwen.

provider_model_id.description: Model string used with the provider API. null = not recorded (not guessed).

channel.description: official_cn = provider China site (CNY); official_intl = international site (USD).

region.description: Cloud region the price applies to, e.g. cn-beijing; null = not region-specific / not recorded.

currency.description: Native currency of the channel; not converted.

input_per_1m.description: Price per 1M uncached input tokens (lowest tier; peak price where time-of-day pricing exists).

output_per_1m.description: Price per 1M output tokens (same tier rules).

cached_per_1m.description: Price per 1M cached input tokens (cache read/hit). null = not published/recorded.

off_peak_input_per_1m.description: Off-peak input price; only for channels whose official page publishes off-peak prices, else null.

off_peak_cached_per_1m.description: Off-peak cached input price; else null.

off_peak_hours.description: Off-peak window as published by the provider; else null.

tier_notes.description: Free-text notes: tiers, cache-write prices, batch discounts, time-limited promotions, region.

retired.description: true if this model name is retired, deprecated, or listed with an OpenRouter-only expiration. The row is kept but must not be ranked as cheapest.

retired_status.description: retired = vendor retired the name (may be served/billed as another model); deprecated = vendor announced a shutdown date; openrouter_expiration = only OpenRouter lists an expiration (no vendor notice). null when retired=false.

retired_shutdown.description: Announced shutdown / expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD) when known; null otherwise.

retired_replacement.description: Recommended replacement model_id (apiprice slug) when the vendor names one; null otherwise.

retired_note.description: Free-text note about retirement / deprecation / expiration.

retired_source_url.description: Official (or OpenRouter, for openrouter_expiration) source for the retirement status.

retired_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 time the retirement status was checked.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the price was read.

check_method.description: auto = fetched by script (static HTML/API); manual = read by a person with a headless browser.

stale.description: true if verified_at is older than 7 days, the last fetch failed, or an announced price change took effect without re-verification.

fetch_failed_reason.description: Reason of the last failed fetch (last good price kept); null if none.

fetch_failed_at.description: Time of the last failed fetch; null if none.

source_url.description: Official pricing page the price was read from.

access_direct.description: Usable from mainland China without a proxy. null = unknown/unverified (shown as ? on apiprice.app), not "no".

access_alipay.description: Alipay accepted. null = unknown/unverified (shown as ? on apiprice.app), not "no".

access_real_name.description: Real-name / ID verification required. null = unknown/unverified (shown as ? on apiprice.app), not "no".

access_overseas_card.description: Overseas card required. null = unknown/unverified (shown as ? on apiprice.app), not "no".

access_region_restricted.description: Space-separated ISO 3166 codes excluded by the provider supported-regions list; null = not recorded.

access_source_url.description: Source URL for the payment / ID flags.

access_verified_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the access flags were checked.

provider_country.description: (1.3.0) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the model vendor, only when backed by a public source (the three provider_country_* fields); otherwise null. Never inferred.

provider_country_source_url.description: (1.3.0) Public page supporting provider_country; null iff provider_country is null.

provider_country_basis.description: (1.3.0) Kind of source: terms_of_service, company_page, company_registry or third_party_reference; null iff provider_country is null.

provider_country_verified_at.description: (1.3.0) UTC+8 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the country source was checked; null iff provider_country is null.

pending_recheck.description: (1.3.0) true when the row needs re-verification: verified_at older than recheck_days, last fetch failed, or an announced change took effect after verified_at. Equals pending_recheck_reasons.length > 0.

pending_recheck_reasons.description: (1.3.0) Reasons for pending_recheck; empty when false. In prices.csv joined with ';'.

last_verified_date_utc8.description: (1.3.0) verified_at as a UTC+8 calendar date.
